headline: Etsy marketplace GMS growth sped up to 8.8% and active buyers grew for the first time in two years; FY GMS outlook raised to ~7%.
guidance_note: Q4 marketplace GMS guided to $3.46-3.52bn (~+5-7% YoY); full-year 2026 GMS growth now ~7%, up from mid-single digits after Q2.
key_messages: Etsy marketplace GMS ~$2.65bn, +8.8% YoY (+9.1% FX-neutral), about 190 bps faster than Q2 ex-FX; third straight quarter of acceleration.
Active buyers +1.0% YoY to ~87.5m (TTM), first YoY gain in two years; GMS per active buyer +3.9% YoY (TTM).
App GMS +10.4% vs non-app +7.5%; app share about 47% of GMS. Habitual/repeat buyers rose modestly quarter over quarter (no count given).
Management credits AI personalization with ~2 pts of annualized GMS growth; said early-2026 growth leaned on higher listing prices (tariffs) and FX.
Adj. EBITDA $210.4m (+14.6%, ~30% margin); $33.9m restructuring charge; CFO Lanny Baker leaving March 1, 2027.

consumer.big_ticket: Discretionary marketplace demand accelerated (GMS +8.8%) and buyer count returned to growth; no explicit comment on big-ticket spending found.
consumer.pricing: Management said early-2026 growth was helped by higher listing prices tied to inflation and tariffs, plus FX; CEO said Etsy is focused on experience quality, not on driving price.
consumer.quote: Increasingly confident that our business is now firmly in growth mode (shareholder letter, as quoted in secondary coverage).

macro_read: A highly discretionary, gift-heavy marketplace sped up through Q3 2026 and added buyers, consistent with resilient US goods spending, though part of the growth reflects higher prices rather than volume.
notes: Etsy marketplace GMS now equals consolidated GMS from continuing operations after the Depop and Reverb sales.

Etsy reports GAAP only; eps_adj is GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations ($1.00 vs $0.86). Total diluted EPS is far higher because it includes the Depop sale gain (net income $853.5m incl. $739.9m from discontinued ops).
Depop (sold to eBay, closed July 30, 2026) and Reverb (sold 2025) are excluded; YoY figures are on a continuing-operations basis.
EPS includes a $33.9m pre-tax restructuring charge (12% workforce cut); per-share effect not disclosed, so eps_ex_one_offs is null.
Consensus left null: revenue estimates cited ranged $667.3m-$680.6m; EPS 'consensus' figures were on mismatched bases.
Stock reaction (+5.35%, close $92.35 on Oct 28) comes from a single price-history source; intraday reports ranged +4.2% to +8.5% pre-market.
Take rate reported ~26.2% by one secondary source only.
